post.summary: Uploads an image (the request body is the file). Uploading bytes that are already stored returns the existing asset.

200.description: the same file was already stored

422.description: not a supported image, too many pixels, or damaged

get.summary: Every variable, snippet and glossary term.

put.summary: Creates or changes a snippet. One that would include itself is refused, with the chain in the message.

422.description: not a usable name, or the snippet would include itself

put.summary: Creates or changes a glossary term. A marked term shows its definition on hover and links to the generated Glossary page.

409.description: pages or snippets still use it

get.summary: Every live page, ordered by position.

post.summary: Creates a page, or an external link when `external_url` is set, under `parent_id` (or at the root).

409.description: a sibling has the same URL segment

post.summary: Changes the title (the URL segment follows it) and, for a link, its target.

409.description: a sibling has the same URL segment

delete.summary: Deletes a page and its descendants.

post.summary: Adds an alias: an old URL that redirects to the page.

409.description: the path belongs to another page or alias; the message names it

delete.summary: Removes an alias of the page.

get.summary: The pages that link to this one.

put.summary: Sets the page's short description, shown on link cards and in its meta tags.

get.summary: The latest saved edits of a page (an empty document if it has none yet).

put.summary: Saves a draft. Refused with 409 when `base_revision_id` is not the page's latest revision.

409.description: the page changed since the revision this save was based on

put.summary: Shows the page in the site header, or takes it out. A promoted page with subpages gets a sidebar of its own.

422.description: links cannot be shown in the header

get.summary: What deleting a page would affect: its subpages and every page that links into them.

post.summary: Moves a page and its subtree under another parent.

409.description: a sibling has the same URL segment

422.description: the target is inside the page's own subtree

get.summary: The page's URL, custom URL and aliases.

put.summary: Sets or clears the page's custom URL.

409.description: the URL belongs to another page or alias; the message names it

post.summary: Publishes the latest saved draft of every page as a new release.

422.description: the checks found problems or a page could not be rendered; nothing was published; the details name each page

get.summary: What the next publish would change compared with the live site, and the live URLs it would break.
The problems that would stop a publish right now, each naming its page. An empty list means the site can be published.
Every redirect of the site, with where it leads and whether it is written.

409.description: the path belongs to a page or another redirect; the message names it

422.description: not a usable path or target, or it would make a loop

get.summary: The site name, logo and accent color.

put.summary: Saves the settings. They reach the published site with the next publish.

Asset.description: An uploaded file. The bytes live in the `AssetStore` under the content hash; this is the row that describes them.

placeholder.description: The image's average color, `#rrggbb`, shown while it loads.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the file: two uploads of the same bytes are one asset.

variants.description: The WebP copies made at upload, narrowest first; empty for animated GIFs.

AssetVariant.description: One scaled copy of an image, a WebP file in the `AssetStore` (see `variant_key`).

Backlink.description: A page that links to another.

target_title.description: The page it links to (one of the pages below the one asked about, for a delete).

BrokenLink.description: A link from a page that stays to a page that is going away.

Change.description: One page with something to publish.

new_url.description: The URL after publishing, for pages that still exist.

old_url.description: The URL in the live release, for pages that were already published.

redirected.description: Whether the old URL keeps working through a redirect.

ChangeKind.description: What changed about a page since the live release.

oneOf.description: Insert before this sibling; the page goes last when absent.

external_url.description: Makes the new node an external link to this URL instead of a page.

description.description: Up to 300 characters; empty clears it.

Document.description:
A page body: the ProseMirror JSON of the editor, stored and rendered as is.

Block nodes carry a stable `attrs.id` (Tiptap UniqueID); internal links and components store page IDs and props in `attrs`.

oneOf.description: The revision this draft is at; the next save must name it.

EntryKind.description: What kind of reusable content an entry is.

ErrorBody.description: The body of every error response.

linked_from.description: Pages outside the deleted ones that link to any of them.

subpages.description: How many pages go with it.

Inactive.description: Why a redirect is not written, if it is not: a page now lives at its path, its page is gone, or it is part of a loop.

LibraryEntry.description: A variable, snippet or glossary term of the library, with the pages that use it.

text_value.description: The value of a variable, or the definition of a term.

LinkKind.description: How a page refers to another.

LostUrl.description: A URL that works on the live site and will not after publishing.

redirect.description: Keep the old URLs of the page and its subtree working with redirects. Defaults to true.

Page.description: A node of the page tree.

description.description: A short summary, shown on link cards and in the page's meta description.

external_url.description: Where a link goes; always `None` for pages.

header_position.description: Orders the header entries (fractional index, like `position`).

in_header.description: Shown as an entry of the site header; a page with children also gets a sidebar of its own.

path_override.description: A fixed URL that replaces the one derived from the tree (`/webhooks/`); it stays put when the page moves.

position.description: Fractional index; siblings sort by this string.

PageId.description: Stable identity of a page; URLs derive from the tree, never from this.

PageKind.description: What a tree node is: a page of the site or a link to somewhere else.

PageUrl.description: Where a page lives and which old URLs lead to it.

derived_url.description: The URL it would have without a custom one.

url.description: The URL the page has now.

broken_links.description: Links that would point at a deleted page: they render as plain text.

Problem.description: A problem that stops a publish, with the page it is on.

ProblemKind.description: What a pre-publish check found wrong.

RedirectEntry.description: A redirect as the Settings page shows it.

oneOf.description: Why it is not written to the site, when it is not.

to.description: Where it leads now, after following chains; absent when it is not written.

to_page_title.description: Title of the page it leads to, when it leads to a page.

Release.description: An immutable published state of the whole site.

oneOf.description: The live release this one was built on.

page_count.description: How many pages the release contains.

ReleaseId.description: An immutable published state of the whole site.

external_url.description: The new target of a link; refused for pages.

redirect.description: Keep the old URL working with a redirect. Defaults to true.

RevisionId.description: An immutable snapshot of a page's document.

oneOf.description: The `base_revision_id` of the draft this edit started from, or null if the page had no draft.

custom_url.description: The fixed URL, or null to use the one derived from the tree.

redirect.description: Keep the old URLs of the page and the pages below it as redirects. Defaults to true.

Settings.description: The site-wide settings of the theme basics.

oneOf.description: An uploaded image shown before the site name in the header.

UserId.description: A user, including the built-in local one.
